messages:
deploy-bot: Canary alert for rollout v3.7.0-canary -> error_rate spike (p50 errors: 2.1%, p95 errors: 6.2%) across eu-west-1. Suggested: AUTO-ROLLBACK to v3.6.9. /details <https://deploy.internal/reports/4799012345|canary-report>

maria: seeing this — hold the auto-rollback for 5m? This rollout touches dedicated pools; need SRE input before impacting customers.

eli: +1 hold. Oncall here, pulling logs now. Any specific customer sessions affected?

nina: logs show KV cache mismatch on new kernel flag kvcache_v2. Errors are transient on warmups, but rate is spiking on long seqs. Sample trace: ```ERROR: kv_mismatch at req=0x7f2c; seq=2048; model=v3.7.0-canary```

jon: that matches the local repro I ran on a 4k seq workload, 2/10 runs failed with kv checksum. Can we scope to canary traffic only?

maria: deploy-bot suggested full rollback. I propose a targeted rollback for Dedicated pools only and pin hosted to v3.6.9 for safety. Thoughts?

eli: Targeted rollback makes sense. Customer-facing infra should stay on stable. If we pin hosted now we avoid a blast radius. Nina, can you confirm if a partial rollback will clear the error?

nina: Partial rollback should remove kvcache_v2 from the Dedicated paths. Plan: 1) manual pin hosted -> v3.6.9 2) rollback Dedicated pool to v3.6.9 3) keep canary in isolated staging until root cause. I can run the rollback playbook.

maria: approve. Action: @eli please run manual override for deploy-bot to disable auto-rollback and pin the hosted route. Then @eli + @nina execute targeted rollback.

eli: running override now: `deployctl override --rollback-policy auto:disable --scope hosted` -> ACK. Next: `deployctl pin --route hosted --version v3.6.9 --reason "canary kv checksum spike"`

deploy-bot: Manual command received. Auto-rollback disabled for this rollout by eli. Hosted route pinned to v3.6.9. Audit: <https://audit.internal/4799012345|events>.

jon: I'll draft a short customer comm for Dedicated users in case they see degraded inference. Carla, want to review before sending?

carla: yes pls. Keep it factual and include mitigation steps + ETA. Suggest: "We detected internal stability issues in a canary build and rolled affected Dedicated pools back to the previous stable version. No action required; performance may have brief variability while we stabilize."

maria: perfect. Eli and Nina, estimate rollback time and when we can resume canary.

nina: rolling back Dedicated pool now. Expected 8-12m to drain and redeploy. I will monitor p95 and error_rate.

eli: confirmed pin applied, Dedicated rollback started at 4799012388. Will update when p95 < baseline and errors < 1%.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics trending down after targeted rollback. p95 latency steady, error_rate -> 0.9% (under threshold).

maria: excellent. Jon, send comms. Nina, keep canary paused and create a test harness for longer seqs before re-enabling kvcache_v2. We'll reconvene in 30m to decide whether to reattempt canary or ship a patch.

eli: update: Dedicated rollback completed at 4799012460. Metrics stable. Re-enable auto-rollback? Maria: your call.

maria: keep auto-rollback disabled until root cause RCA. We'll do a controlled re-run after Nina's extended tests. Closing this thread for now. :white_check_mark:
